knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The route is assessed and the plan approved before items move. Speed and loading first are not permitted.
Migration outside the zone requires a stop and a reassessment.

practicalCriteria: On a fictional property diagram, the learner marks the supervised zones and the handoff points and shows which areas are kept apart. Pass: zones, handoffs and separation are all marked.
The learner writes three reassessment triggers for the diagram. Pass: each trigger names the action taken.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: The route passes shared or occupied space without an approved plan.
Public access or migration outside the zone is observed.
